free_tier.stated: $15/month of free resource consumption per pay-as-you-go org = 50M Request Units + 10 GiB storage/month

egress.terms: No separate egress charge on Basic — billing is storage GiB + Request Units. So egress is effectively free within the RU budget, and reads are the meter.

tooling: Postgres wire protocol (psql, any driver), `cockroach` CLI, Cloud API; no object storage — bytes must live in tables/BYTEA
chaining: The $15 credit is per ORGANIZATION and explicitly spendable 'across all CockroachDB Basic clusters in an organization'. It is a monthly consumable, not a standing quota — 10 GiB is the storage-equivalent, and multi-region replication multiplies storage 3-5x against the same credit. New orgs get a $400 trial credit on top.
limits_note: 10 GiB/month equivalent; hitting the storage limit blocks writes ('cluster will be unable to write to its storage'); hitting the RU limit disables the cluster until next cycle. Pricing changed for deployments created on/after 2026-09-15 ('Cockroach Continuum').

reliability_note: Cluster is DISABLED when RU budget is exhausted — a hard stop mid-month, not throttling. Replication factor 3 eats the storage budget 3x.
